retailers.name: Amazon
retailers.scopes_included: Scope 1+2 (market-based)+3. Scope 1 and 3 are net of EAC insets (gross assured Scope 1 is 15.41 Mt).
retailers.fact: Emissions rose 16% in 2025 on data center growth; electricity emissions up 34%.

src.name: Amazon 2025 Sustainability Report (Data Tables: Amazon's 2019-2025 Carbon Footprint)
src.where: Appendix, Data Tables, p.46; Scope 1/2 assurance: https://sustainability.aboutamazon.com/2025-ghg-assurance-scope-1-2.pdf

retailers.note: 2024 restated to 69.55 Mt (originally 68.25 Mt). Change is vs restated 2024.

retailers.name: Walmart
retailers.scopes_included: Scope 1+2 (market-based)+3. Scope 3 is an estimate of Categories 1, 2, 11, 12 in key markets (>95% of Scope 3). Total computed by summing.
retailers.fact: Missed 2025 SBTi target: Scope 1+2 down 24.6% vs FY2016, short of 35% goal.

src.name: Walmart FY2026 ESG Report
src.where: PDF p.30 (FY2026 Operational Emissions Results), p.36 (FY2026 Scope 3 Progress), p.126 (data table)

retailers.note: Fiscal year FY2026 = Feb 2025 to Jan 2026. Total is our sum (14.4 + 635); Walmart does not print a combined total. Project Gigaton cumulative is now 1.37 Gt (lead of 1.19 Gt is outdated).

retailers.name: Target
retailers.scopes_included: Scope 1+2 (market-based)+3 (10 relevant categories, incl. optional guest travel). Total computed by summing.
retailers.fact: Hit 100% renewable electricity; pushed Scope 3 goal to 2035 and net zero to no later than 2050.

src.name: Target 2026 Sustainability and Governance Report Appendix (FY2025)
src.where: Data Tables, Climate, GHG Emissions table, p.17

retailers.note: FY2025 = year ended Jan 31, 2026. FY2024 Scope 3 restated to 57.76 Mt (lead said 58.88 Mt). Scope 2 market-based fell from 0.64 to 0.012 Mt via RECs; location-based Scope 2 is 1.41 Mt.

retailers.name: Shein
retailers.scopes_included: Scope 1+2 (market-based)+3, as reported total. Verified by Bureau Veritas (ISO 14064-1).
retailers.fact: Purchased goods (manufacturing) is the biggest source at 11.4 Mt; Scope 3 up 20.3% vs 2023 base.

src.name: SHEIN 2025 Sustainability and Social Impact Report (2025 GHG Emissions Inventory)
src.where: Planet, Decarbonise Our Value Chain, 2025 GHG Emissions Inventory, p.52 (category split p.53)

retailers.note: 2024 total is 26.20 Mt. The 28.9 figure seen in press is the same 26.2 Mt expressed in US short tons.

retailers.name: Temu (PDD Holdings)
retailers.fact: PDD publishes no GHG inventory; its FY2025 20-F never mentions emissions or climate.

src.name: PDD Holdings Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (filed 2026-04-29)
src.where: Full-text search: zero hits for greenhouse, carbon, emission, climate, ESG. No ESG section on investor.pddholdings.com.

retailers.name: eBay
retailers.scopes_included: Scope 1+2 (market-based)+3 (material categories 1-7, 9; use of sold products no longer included). Total computed by summing.
retailers.fact: Shipping of items sold on eBay is about 83% of Scope 3; assurer flagged outdated GLEC factors.

src.name: eBay Impact Report 2025
src.where: Sustainable Commerce, GHG Emissions and Scope 3 GHG Emissions by Category tables, p.34

retailers.note: 2024 Scope 3 restated to 1.778 Mt. 2024 Scope 1+2 is 5,244 t in the PDF but 5,097 t on ebayinc.com/impact/sustainable-commerce.
